title: Owner-authorized runtime observation v2
alt: An authorized caller reads Orchestrator-owned runtime facts through the Gateway. The owner rechecks current project and run authority, the accepted selection, the root or child session, and the execution fence. History pages use a repeatable-read snapshot and a committed high-water mark; later pages keep that mark. Exact attempt lookup is separate from paging. Missing legacy coverage and native proof remain explicitly incomplete or unavailable. Responses contain no prompt, tool arguments, tool results, credentials, or raw native cursor. This source does not prove deployment or live runtime activity.
